text:
Maya Chen: planning a public announce + technical webinar. target date: Tue 2025-12-09 10:00am PT. need canonical docs URL, changelog anchor, concise bench blurb for the hero, and the webinar sign-up flow wired into HubSpot. who owns eng handoff?
Samira Khan: I can draft hero + social. need final test numbers and the exact docs link to embed in the blog and newsletter. also want a 1-sentence tagline we can A/B test.
Evan Brooks: eng can own changelog publish. propose changelog freeze Mon 6pm PT, docs live Mon 11:59pm PT. will avoid internal names in public text.
Alex Rivera: confirm well publish at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1954 and add #changelog anchor. will push before midnight Monday.
Jordan Patel: bench context: runs on g5.2x, seq_len=512, batch=20, warm KV. observed p99 down 11.2%, p50 down 8.9%, token cost down 12.7% using quant-D + prefix cache. note: micro-burst single-token calls are within noise.
Samira Khan: marketing will round to: "~11% lower p99 latency; ~13% lower token cost." include full hardware and test matrix in an appendix link. drafting two tagline options: A) "Faster inference, lower cost" B) "Performance and efficiency for real workloads" — prefer A for the hero.
Linh Tran: tagging announce-bot to schedule the rollout window once docs are live. announce-bot: please schedule canary at announce time with 60m watch and notify #eng-oncall #eng-sre.
announce-bot: scheduled canary 2025-12-09T10:00:00-08:00, watch 60m, notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre.
Maya Chen: inbound routing: rule set - if company_size > 75 OR plan_hint=="enterprise" -> SDR-Enterprise; edu/gov -> Partnerships; otherwise nurture list. Samira add a hidden "lead_tier" computed in the form JS and pass account metadata fields: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint.
Samira Khan: will add hidden field and wire to HubSpot. CTA copy draft: "Reserve a seat for the 12/11 technical deep-dive" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release1954. will include javascript placeholders for lead_tier and account_id.
Alex Rivera: for embed, field names we expose: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint. sample JSON snippet marketing can embed (paste as string in the blog): ``{"release":"v1954","p99_reduction":"11.2%","token_cost_reduction":"12.7%","hw":"g5.2x"}``
Jordan Patel: rollout plan: t0 canary 5%, t+30m 25%, t+90m 100% if metrics stable. monitor p99, error_rate, qps, token_cost. fallback policy: `fallback_policy: revert_on_error_rate(1.4x)`.
Maya Chen: timeline recap: Mon 18:00 changelog freeze, Mon 23:59 docs live, Tue 08:00 beta preflight email to early access, Tue 10:00 public announce + blog + social + webinar modal. Samira post drafts Mon noon for review.
Samira Khan: acknowledged. will post drafts and two hero taglines for quick A/B feedback by Mon 12:00 PT. also adding a short methodology blurb for the press kit.
Alex Rivera: will drop the final docs link here when live and ping when the anchor is up.
Linh Tran: playbook note: if error_rate > 1.25x baseline during watch window, auto-fallback to previous model version. I'll share the canary playbook link with #marketing once it's uploaded.
Maya Chen: great. final asks: Alex post docs link; Jordan share playbook; Samira post marketing drafts at Mon noon. we'll reconvene Mon afternoon if any numbers shift. :rocket:
